title: Dog at Retro Computer
description: A brown and white dog with large pointed ears sits at a white desk between two old computers. Its front paws rest on a keyboard while a brown and red object lies on the desk in front of it; the left monitor shows text and the right computer has a damaged case.
prompt: A brown and white dog with large pointed ears and a black collar sits upright at a white desk with its front paws on a keyboard looking forward. An old gray CRT monitor on the left displays text while a beige computer tower on the right has a broken case with exposed screen. A brown and red object rests on the desk in front of the dog against a plain neutral background in a realistic painted style.
